name: directory
description: Directory: a modular, offline-capable personal operating environment.

scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy -p directory-core --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p directory-worker --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && npm run typecheck -w @directory/web
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:handoff && npm run build && npm run build:worker
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.ci: npm run verify && npm run smoke && npm run test:browser
